children: MediaTek unveiled a new flagship smartphone processor built with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company's
most advanced chipmaking technology, stepping up its push into the premium handset market and the growing on-device artificial intelligence business.

The Dimensity 9600 Pro is MediaTek’s first smartphone processor manufactured using TSMC’s 2-nanometer process, the company said on Tuesday. It also introduced the Dimensity 9600M, produced on TSMC’s 3-nanometer technology and targeting a wider portion of the flagship segment. Phones using both processors are expected to reach the market soon.

The 9600 Pro features a dedicated neural-processing unit designed to run more sophisticated generative AI workloads directly on smartphones. MediaTek said the component improves prompt processing by 51% from the prior generation before an AI model begins producing an answer.
The launch comes as MediaTek seeks to gain ground on Qualcomm
in higher-end smartphones, where rising prices and demand for AI capabilities are creating opportunities for chipmakers to capture better margins. MediaTek’s market value surpassed Qualcomm’s
For gaming, the chip offers up to 27% higher peak performance while using 24% less power at peak performance. It also brings faster ray tracing and supports gaming at up to 185 frames per second.

The company is also expanding beyond handsets into AI infrastructure and custom silicon. Its first AI accelerator developed for a major US cloud provider is expected to enter mass production in the fourth quarter.
